observations.text: Plans (yearly view): Starter $0 — 300 cr./mo (≈4 Nano Banana Pro generations), 'Your Current Plan'; Pro $17.91/mo — 20,000 cr. + $4 Free Gens (=250 Nano Banana Pro / 2,200 GPT Image 2); Ultimate $44.91 — 50,000 cr. + $38 Free Gens + Unlimited Pack; Infinite $399.92 — 500,000 cr. + $188 Free Gens + Unlimited Pack. 'Free Gens' are per-model quotas (e.g. Seedance 2.5 up to 5/50/250).

Credit model is a single 'cr.' balance plus per-model free-generation quotas plus an 'Unlimited Pack/Mode' for top models on higher tiers. The composer's 'Unlimited Mode' toggle is the client-side face of that pack.

Client-cached model catalog (localStorage global_models, 70 models) lists per-model prices in credits: text models per token (e.g. GPT 4.1 prompt 2 / completion 8; Claude Fable 5 10/50), image models flat (Seedream 5.0 Pro 45,000; Nano Banana Pro 80,000; Z Image Turbo 5,000), video flat (Kling 3.0 4K 2,100,000; Veo 3.1 Fast 600,000). Units are internal credits, not 'cr.' — the exchange rate is not shown (U). Chat modes in the catalog: 0 chat, 1, 2 image, 4, 5, 9 video, 10.
The upgrade modal auto-opened on entering a flow with 0 credits; the '0% credits remaining, upgrade here' toast is persistent on every canvas.
/notifications is a full route listing account notifications.
